PLAN "12-week PCOS resistance programme"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Improve body composition and insulin sensitivity"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower strength":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        accessory straight_sets:
          plank 3x30..45 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper strength":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        accessory straight_sets:
          bicep_curl 2x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full body metabolic":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 6m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x5..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lung e 0x0 rpe 0 rest 0 seconds
        accessory straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 2x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 2x30..45 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
